description: Two voltage-controlled voltage processors, each working out A times B plus C, with switchable gain on both B and C

params.text: Sets the gain applied to the B input of that section before its attenuator: x-1, x1 or x2
Attenuates the B input of that section, from silence at the bottom to its full level at the top
Sets the gain applied to the C input of that section before its attenuator: x-1, x1 or x2
Attenuates the C input of that section, from silence at the bottom to its full level at the top
Picks what happens between the two sections: Mix adds section 1 into OUT2 whenever OUT 1 has no cable, and Mult normals a copy of A1 into the A2 input whenever A2 has no cable

inputs.text: One factor of the multiplication in that section; it is multiplied by B and divided by 5V
The other factor of the multiplication in that section, scaled by that section's B knob and gain switch; with nothing patched it stands at 5V, which turns the knob into a plain attenuator for A
The offset added to the product in that section, scaled by that section's C knob and gain switch; with nothing patched it stands at 5V, which turns the knob into an offset control

outputs.text: The first section's result, clipped at -10V to 10V
The second section's result, clipped at -10V to 10V, with the first section's result added in when the mode switch is on Mix and OUT 1 has no cable

menu: Clip outputs at ±10V — holds both outputs inside -10V to 10V; on by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
